title: Sergio Was Super Knowledgeable
text: We got lucky in having Sergio as our tour guide. He was tremendously knowledgeable, not only about present day Sevilla but also it's rich African,bArab, Roman, Jewish history. And how Sevilla/Andalucia fits into the rest of Spain and the rest of the world, including the brother relationship with Kansas City, Missouri, USA. Great experience!
author: gbdunn
